en.headline: Fire on moored barge at Ngong Shuen Chau extinguished after about 90 minutes
en.dek: Firefighters put out a blaze on a pontoon near Ang Yan Road by 11:18am on Saturday; 15 people were evacuated and no injuries were reported.
body: The Fire Services Department responded to a fire on a moored barge off Ang Yan Road at Ngong Shuen Chau on Saturday morning.

Firefighters received the report at about 9:52am and deployed two hoses and two breathing apparatus teams. The fire was largely extinguished by 11:18am, after which crews continued spraying water to cool the vessel. Fifteen people were evacuated. No injuries were reported.
The department advised that anyone affected by drifting smoke or odour should stay indoors, close doors and windows, and remain calm. The cause of the fire is under investigation.

zh.headline: 昂船洲貲船起火約九十分鐘後救熄 十五人疏散無人傷
zh.dek: 消防今早近十時接報昂船洲昂運路對開貲船火警，十一時十八分大致救熄，呼籲受煙霧影響市民留室內關窗。
body: 消防處今早接報昂船洲昂運路對開一艘已泊岸貲船發生火警。
消防人員約上午九時五十二分到場，動用兩條喉及兩隊煙帽隊撲救。火勢於上午十一時十八分大致救熄，其後繼續射水降溫。事件中十五人需要疏散，暫無受傷報告。
消防處呼籲，如市民受到隨風飄散的煙霧和異味影響，請盡量留在室內及關閉門窗，並保持鎮定。火警原因有待調查。
